spec.description: volkeep backup daemon for Docker volumes.

spec.expr: count(count by (hostname) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` [$__range])))

spec.description:
- Snapshots in repo — current inventory, ≈ retention days; same-day snapshots collapse under `keep-daily`
- Logical — uncompressed size
- Physical — on-disk size
- Added in range — packed bytes written, before prune

spec.expr: sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap snapshots [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass finished"` | logfmt | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_uncompressed_size [$__range])) / max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_uncompressed_size [$__range]))
max by (hostname) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000
sum by (hostname) (sum_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | logfmt | unwrap data_added_packed [$__range]))

spec.description:
One row per volume backup.

- Size — data read, logical
- Added — new data before compression; – is unchanged
- Stopped / Exec — container stopped, pre-hook ran

spec.expr: {syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `msg="Backup (finished|failed|completed)` | logfmt | volume=~`$volume` | keep hostname, volume, duration_ms, exit, msg, bytes_processed, data_added, stopped, exec, snapshot_id

value.title: View daemon log for this backup

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `msg="Backup (finished|failed|completed)` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Volume size
spec.description: Logical size of the backed-up data per volume.

spec.expr: max by (hostname, volume) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | logfmt | volume=~`$volume` | unwrap bytes_processed [$__interval]))

spec.title: Pass duration
spec.description: Whole pass per host: all volumes plus forget/sweep/prune/check.

spec.expr: max by (hostname) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass finished"` | logfmt | unwrap duration_ms [$__interval]))
avg by (hostname, volume) (avg_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup finished"` | logfmt | volume=~`$volume` | unwrap duration_ms [$__interval]))
max by (hostname) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [$__interval]))

spec.title: Total repo size
spec.description: Latest known physical repository size per host (2 d lookback), summed.

spec.expr: sum(max by (hostname) (last_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository stats"` | logfmt | unwrap total_size [2d])))

spec.description: Every daemon line, or errors only via the Errors only switch. Worker (`restic`) stdout is a separate stream.

spec.expr: {syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} | logfmt | level=~`$errors_only` | regexp `^time=\S*?(?P<tz>[+-][0-9:]{5}|Z) ` | line_format `host={{.hostname}} tz={{ regexReplaceAll "^Z$" .tz "+00:00" }} {{ regexReplaceAll "^time=\\S+ level=\\S+ " (__line__) "" }}`

spec.title: Passes by trigger
spec.description: Whole-host backup passes by trigger. A pass that reports no trigger does not chart.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass starting"` | logfmt | trigger=`schedule` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass starting"` | logfmt | trigger=`manual` [$__interval]))

spec.description: One row per whole-host pass. Failed counts volumes not backed up. A pass that reports no counters fills only Finished, Host and Duration.

spec.expr: {syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass finished"` | logfmt | keep hostname, trigger, containers, volumes, failed, data_added, duration_ms

value.title: View volume backups from this pass

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup pass starting"` [$__interval]))

100 * (sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Backup failed"` [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `msg="Backup (finished|failed|completed)` [$__range]))

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: All ERROR-level daemon events (backup, forget, sweep, prune, check, exec).

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `level=ERROR` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Warnings
spec.description: WARN-level daemon events: partial backups with unreadable files, stale lock removals.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `level=WARN` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} |= `msg="Repository check failed"` [$__interval]))
sum by (detected_level) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/volkeep", hostname=~"$hostname"} | logfmt level | level=~`$errors_only` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Volkeep

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only errors in the Daemon Log.
